name: io.asgardeo.android.oidc.sdk.activity.TokenManagementActivity
description: The Asgardeo Android sign-in SDK opens this screen after the identity provider returns an authorization result. It exchanges that result for access and identity tokens, updates the signed-in user, and returns success or cancellation to the app.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents Asgardeo sign-in from finishing the token exchange and returning its result to the app.
